# `ascii`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the numeric value of the first character of `str`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
ascii(str)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- ascii, example 1
> SELECT ascii('222');
50
```

```sql
-- ascii, example 2
> SELECT ascii(2);
50
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
